1050.name: Commercially pure aluminium
1050.h1: 1050 O Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Coil, Foil — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
1050.metaTitle: 1050 O Aluminium Coil Supplier — Foil & Busbar | Zorlang
1050.metaDesc: 1050 O aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube, coil and foil for foil & busbar from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
1050.intro: 1050 is the conductivity grade: 99.5 % aluminium, no deliberate alloying, rolled O-temper so it bends and anodises without argument. Busbar, heat-sink fin, a nameplate that has to stay bright after forming — the specification starts here. Rolled 0.2–4 mm and slit to the width your press needs.

apps.d: Busbar, heat-exchanger fins and transformer strip, where conductivity matters more than yield strength.
Takes a bright, uniform anodic film — used for sign blanks, reflectors and decorative trim.
Cookware, closures and lamp housings that need elongation above 20% in the O temper.

compare.1100: 1100 adds a small copper addition for slightly higher strength and better machinability, at the cost of a little conductivity. Choose 1100 when the part is formed and machined; stay with 1050 for conductors.
compare.3003: 3003 roughly doubles the yield strength of 1050 through manganese and still welds cleanly. Move to 3003 as soon as the part has to carry load, not just shape.

1050.qc: Composition is verified by optical emission spectrometry on every heat. Conductivity is measured on strip, and flatness is checked on a granite table before the sheet is cut to length. Mill test certificate, dimensional report and, on request, SGS inspection are issued against the heat number.

1100.name: Commercially pure aluminium
1100.h1: 1100 O Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Coil, Foil — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
1100.metaTitle: 1100 O Aluminium Coil Supplier — Foil Stock | Zorlang
1100.metaDesc: 1100 O aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube, coil and foil for foil stock from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
1100.intro: Halfway between 1050 and the manganese grades, 1100 trades a little conductivity for workability: 99 % aluminium with a trace of copper that keeps deep-drawn holloware from tearing at the flange. Nameplates, heat-exchanger fins and packaging containers all lean on that balance. O-temper, 0.2–4 mm, slit and levelled.

apps.d: Cookware, holloware and lamp reflectors where the metal is spun or drawn to shape.
Fins and plates in radiators and heat exchangers, thanks to high thermal conductivity.
Caps, closures and container components that need a clean surface and tight gauge.

compare.1050: 1050 is purer and slightly more conductive; 1100 is stronger and machines better. If the part is punched or turned after forming, 1100 usually wins.
compare.3003: 3003 is the stronger, more corrosion-resistant option, but it anodises less brightly. Keep 1100 where surface appearance matters.

1100.qc: Each heat is spectro-checked and the coil is slit to the ordered width in-house. Surface is inspected under raking light for roll marks and inclusions, and thickness is logged every 20 metres.

2011.name: Free-machining aluminium
2011.h1: 2011 T3 Aluminium Bar, Tube — GB/T 6892 · ASTM B221
2011.metaTitle: 2011 T3 Aluminium Bar Supplier — Free Machining | Zorlang
2011.metaDesc: 2011 T3 aluminium (aluminum) bar and tube for free machining from a China mill. ASTM B221 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
2011.intro: 2011 is free-machining stock. Bismuth and lead are added so the chip breaks cleanly and the tool keeps its edge, which is why precision screws, connectors and turned optical parts are run from it on high-speed automatics. Supplied as bar from Ø 6 to 300 mm in T3, cut to the length your machine wants.

2017.name: Riveting aluminium (2A11 equivalent)
2017.h1: 2017 T4 Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
2017.metaTitle: 2017 T4 Aluminium Bar Supplier — Free Machining | Zorlang
2017.metaDesc: 2017 T4 aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar and tube for free machining from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
2017.intro: One of the original aircraft alloys, and still doing the job where a rivet has to be driven cold and hold. Copper and magnesium carry the strength, manganese keeps the grain uniform through the shank. T4 bar, Ø 6–300 mm, for rivets, bolts, clamps and structural repair stock.

3003.name: Manganese anti-rust alloy
3003.h1: 3003 H14 Aluminium Plate, Tube, Coil, Foil, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
3003.metaTitle: 3003 H14 Aluminium Plate Supplier — Cookware | Zorlang
3003.metaDesc: 3003 H14 aluminium (aluminum) plate, tube, coil, foil and profile for cookware from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
3003.intro: 3003 is the general-purpose workhorse: manganese in solid solution lifts strength well clear of the 1xxx grades without costing formability or corrosion resistance. Cookware, radiators, fuel tanks, roofing — the range of uses tells you how uncontroversial it is. Rolled 0.2–150 mm in H14, so one alloy serves as sheet and as plate.

apps.d: Profiled sheet, fascia and gutters that face weather for decades without coating failure.
Truck bodies, tank shells and container panels where weight and weldability both matter.
Ducting, heat-exchanger shells and storage vessels handling mildly corrosive media.

compare.1100: 3003 costs a little more and is roughly twice as strong, with better corrosion resistance. It replaces 1100 in almost every structural or outdoor part.
compare.5052: 5052 adds magnesium for a further 50% strength and better marine performance, but is harder to form tightly. Use 5052 when strength is the constraint, 3003 when formability is.

3003.qc: Manganese content is checked per heat because it drives the strength. Bend and tensile tests are run on the first coil of each batch, and tube is eddy-current tested on request.

3004.name: Manganese-magnesium roofing alloy
3004.h1: 3004 H32 Aluminium Plate, Tube, Coil — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
3004.metaTitle: 3004 H32 Aluminium Plate Supplier — Roofing Coil | Zorlang
3004.metaDesc: 3004 H32 aluminium (aluminum) plate, tube and coil for roofing coil from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
3004.intro: Add magnesium to the 3003 formula and you get 3004: noticeably stronger, still roll-formable, still corrosion-resistant. That combination is why profiled roofing, curtain-wall panels and chemical storage tanks are built from it. H32 is the usual delivery temper. Rolled 0.2–150 mm, mill finish or coated.

3104.name: Can body stock
3104.h1: 3104 H19 Aluminium Plate, Coil — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
3104.metaTitle: 3104 H19 Aluminium Coil Supplier — Can Body Stock | Zorlang
3104.metaDesc: 3104 H19 aluminium (aluminum) plate and coil for can body stock from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
3104.intro: Built for draw-and-iron. 3104 holds the strength and ductility balance that lets a can body thin its wall without splitting, and it survives the lacquer bake afterwards. Beverage can bodies, food cans, closures. H19, 0.2–4 mm, gauge held tight enough for a high-speed bodymaker.

4032.name: Piston alloy
4032.h1: 4032 T6 Aluminium Bar — GB/T 6892 · ASTM B221
4032.metaTitle: 4032 T6 Aluminium Bar Supplier — Forged Pistons | Zorlang
4032.metaDesc: 4032 T6 aluminium (aluminum) bar for forged pistons from a China mill. ASTM B221 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
4032.intro: Low expansion is the whole point of 4032. Around 12 % silicon keeps a forged piston from growing away from its bore as it comes up to temperature, and the nickel and copper additions hold strength where the crown gets hottest. T6 bar, Ø 6–300 mm, for pistons and cylinder-head inserts.

4045.name: Silicon brazing alloy
4045.h1: 4045 O Aluminium Bar, Coil — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
4045.metaTitle: 4045 O Aluminium Coil Supplier — Brazing Sheet | Zorlang
4045.metaDesc: 4045 O aluminium (aluminum) bar and coil for brazing sheet from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
4045.intro: 4045 is a brazing alloy before it is a structural one. Around 10 % silicon drops its melting point below the core it is clad onto, so on the brazing cycle the clad flows and the core does not. Cladding for brazing sheet, filler wire, preformed rings. O-temper, 0.2–4 mm, clad or free-standing.

4343.name: Brazing clad layer
4343.h1: 4343 O Aluminium Plate, Coil, Foil — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
4343.metaTitle: 4343 O Aluminium Coil Supplier — Brazing Clad | Zorlang
4343.metaDesc: 4343 O aluminium (aluminum) plate, coil and foil for brazing clad from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
4343.intro: The lower-silicon brazing grade. 4343 melts a little hotter than 4045 and leaves a narrower, more controllable fillet — what automotive radiators and charge-air coolers need when the assembly has to hold pressure after the furnace. O-temper sheet and coil, 0.2–4 mm.

5005.name: Anodising-grade decorative alloy
5005.h1: 5005 H14 Aluminium Plate, Tube, Coil, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
5005.metaTitle: 5005 H14 Aluminium Plate Supplier — Anodised Sheet | Zorlang
5005.metaDesc: 5005 H14 aluminium (aluminum) plate, tube, coil and profile for anodised sheet from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
5005.intro: 5005 sits between the pure grades and 5052: enough magnesium for strength, little enough to keep an anodised film even in colour. Curtain-wall panels and decorative trim come out of it without a patchwork across a façade. H14, 0.2–150 mm, finish quality controlled at the mill rather than left to the anodiser.

5052.name: General-purpose marine aluminium
5052.h1: 5052 H32 Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Coil, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
5052.metaTitle: 5052 H32 Aluminium Plate Supplier — Fuel Tanks | Zorlang
5052.metaDesc: 5052 H32 aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube, coil and profile for fuel tanks from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
5052.intro: The most widely used of the 5xxx sheet alloys, and deservedly so: 2.5 % magnesium with chromium gives marine-grade corrosion resistance, good fatigue life, and enough ductility to form a fuel tank or a pressure vessel without cracking at the weld prep. H32 standard, O and H34 on request. 0.2–150 mm.

apps.d: Hulls, decks, superstructures and fittings that live in salt spray and cyclic loading.
Truck, bus and generator tanks, where weld integrity and corrosion resistance are critical.
Electrical cabinets, machine guards and architectural panels that need stiffness and finish.

compare.3003: 3003 is more formable and cheaper; 5052 is about 50% stronger and far better in salt water. The switch is normally driven by strength or marine exposure.
compare.5083: 5083 raises magnesium to 4.5% for welded marine structures and pressure vessels. It needs H116/H321 temper control and costs more; 5052 covers most sheet-metal work.

5052.qc: Magnesium and chromium are verified per heat. Tensile and bend tests run on every batch, and salt-spray or intergranular corrosion testing is available for marine orders.

5083.name: Marine-grade plate alloy
5083.h1: 5083 H116 Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
5083.metaTitle: 5083 H116 Aluminium Plate Supplier — Marine Grade | Zorlang
5083.metaDesc: 5083 H116 aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube and profile for marine grade from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
5083.intro: 5083 is what you specify when the structure has to live in salt water and stay strong after welding. 4.5 % magnesium, no heat treatment to lose, and H116/H321 tempers that resist sensitisation in service. Hulls and decks, cryogenic and LNG tanks, rail bodies. Rolled 0.2–150 mm on the same line as the thinner plate.

apps.d: Workboats, yachts, fishing vessels and offshore structures built to class rules.
Cryogenic and chemical tanks where low-temperature toughness and weld strength matter.
Tipper bodies, tanker shells and rail components that need strength with low weight.

compare.5052: 5052 is cheaper, easier to form and sufficient for most sheet-metal parts; 5083 is the choice once the structure is welded and loaded, or class-approved.
compare.6061: 6061 is heat-treatable and machinable to tight tolerances but weaker in welded joints and less corrosion resistant in seawater. Use 6061 for machined parts, 5083 for welded marine structure.

5083.qc: Every plate is ultrasonically inspected for internal defects on request, and H116 material is tested to ASTM G67 for intergranular corrosion. Tensile tests are taken transverse to the rolling direction.

5182.name: Can end and tab stock
5182.h1: 5182 H19 Aluminium Plate, Coil — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
5182.metaTitle: 5182 H19 Aluminium Coil Supplier — Can Lid Stock | Zorlang
5182.metaDesc: 5182 H19 aluminium (aluminum) plate and coil for can lid stock from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
5182.intro: Can-end stock. 5182 carries more magnesium than 3104, which buys the strength a lid needs at 0.2 mm and the formability to score it and pull a tab without cracking. Also used for automotive inner panels and closures. H19, 0.2–4 mm.

5754.name: Automotive body sheet
5754.h1: 5754 O Aluminium Plate, Tube, Coil — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
5754.metaTitle: 5754 O Aluminium Plate Supplier — Chemical Plant | Zorlang
5754.metaDesc: 5754 O aluminium (aluminum) plate, tube and coil for chemical plant from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
5754.intro: 5754 is the weldable, formable member of the 5xxx family: around 3 % magnesium, no copper, and an O or H111 temper that takes a bend without springback fighting the press brake. Automotive chassis parts, storage tanks, welded structures. Rolled 0.2–150 mm, sheet and plate off the same line.

6061.name: General structural alloy
6061.h1: 6061 T6 Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
6061.metaTitle: 6061 T6 Aluminium Plate Supplier — Moulds & Tooling | Zorlang
6061.metaDesc: 6061 T6 aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube and profile for moulds & tooling from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
6061.intro: The alloy most machine shops reach for, and the reason is boringly practical: magnesium and silicon give 6061-T6 its strength, chromium holds corrosion resistance, and it machines, welds and anodises without surprises. Moulds and tooling, automation frames, bicycle frames, CNC structural parts. Plate 0.2–150 mm, bar Ø 6–300 mm.

apps.d: Fixture plates, moulds, robotics bases and CNC parts where dimensional stability matters.
Machine frames, gantries, trailer structures and platforms bolted or welded from plate and profile.
Truck components, marine hardware and pressure-rated fittings in T6/T651.

compare.6063: 6063 extrudes into complex profiles with a better anodised finish but is 30–40% weaker. Use 6063 for architectural sections, 6061 where the part is machined or loaded.
compare.7075: 7075 is nearly twice as strong but not weldable and far less corrosion resistant. Specify 7075 only for aerospace-grade machined parts where strength is the limiting factor.

6061.qc: Solution treatment and ageing are logged per furnace load, with hardness checked on every batch and tensile tests per lot. Ultrasonic inspection of thick plate and AMS 4027 certification are available.

6063.name: Architectural extrusion alloy
6063.h1: 6063 T5 Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
6063.metaTitle: 6063 T5 Aluminium Profile Supplier — Extrusion | Zorlang
6063.metaDesc: 6063 T5 aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube and profile for extrusion from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
6063.intro: 6063 is the architectural default because it anodises to an even, bright film and extrudes at speed into thin, complicated walls. Window and curtain-wall profile, handrail, balustrade, heat sinks. T5 standard, wall 0.8–20 mm, section to 400 mm — and we anodise in house, so the finish is not a second supplier's problem.

apps.d: Window and door profiles, curtain wall mullions and cladding sections, anodised or coated.
Finned extrusions for LED luminaires, inverters and power supplies.
T-slot profile, guards and conveyor frames assembled from stock sections.

compare.6061: 6061 is 30–40% stronger and machines better, but extrudes into simpler shapes and anodises less evenly. For a loaded machined part choose 6061; for a visible profile choose 6063.
compare.6005A: 6005A is a little stronger than 6063 and common in European curtain wall. Where EN 755-2 calls for 6005A, we can quote it; 6063 remains the faster, cheaper route for standard sections.

6063.qc: Profile dimensions are checked against the drawing before finishing, and anodic film thickness is measured on every rack. Coating adhesion is tested by impact and bend, with colour measured against the approved sample.

6082.name: High-strength extrusion alloy
6082.h1: 6082 T6 Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
6082.metaTitle: 6082 T6 Aluminium Plate Supplier — Structural | Zorlang
6082.metaDesc: 6082 T6 aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube and profile for structural from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
6082.intro: The strongest of the common 6xxx alloys, and it holds strength at temperature better than 6061. Bridges and structural beams, automotive structural parts, ball studs, forgings. T6, 0.2–150 mm, sawn and machined to drawing when the part has to fit something else.

6101.name: Electrical conductor alloy
6101.h1: 6101 T6 Aluminium Tube, Profile — GB/T 6892 · ASTM B221
6101.metaTitle: 6101 T6 Aluminium Profile Supplier — Busbar | Zorlang
6101.metaDesc: 6101 T6 aluminium (aluminum) tube and profile for busbar from a China mill. ASTM B221 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
6101.intro: Conductivity and strength in one extrusion alloy. 6101 carries current close to what pure aluminium would, yet still takes a T6 temper — which is why busbar trunking, switchgear and EV charging conductors are made from it rather than from 6063. Wall 0.8–20 mm, section to 400 mm, cut to length.

7005.name: Bicycle frame alloy
7005.h1: 7005 T6 Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
7005.metaTitle: 7005 T6 Aluminium Plate Supplier — Frame Tube | Zorlang
7005.metaDesc: 7005 T6 aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube and profile for frame tube from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
7005.intro: 7005 is the weldable 7xxx. Zinc and magnesium put its strength above any 6xxx grade, zirconium keeps the weld zone from softening, and it still takes a bicycle frame or a ski pole without stress-corrosion trouble in service. T6, 0.2–150 mm, plate and extruded section.

8011.name: Closure and pharma foil alloy
8011.h1: 8011 H18 Aluminium Plate, Coil, Foil — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
8011.metaTitle: 8011 H18 Aluminium Foil Supplier — Bottle Caps | Zorlang
8011.metaDesc: 8011 H18 aluminium (aluminum) plate, coil and foil for bottle caps from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
8011.intro: Foil rather than sheet. 8011 rolls down to 0.006 mm with the gauge control blister foil and bottle-cap stock need, and silicon and iron are balanced to give it strength at that gauge. Pharmaceutical blister, sealing gaskets, laminated packaging. 0.006–0.20 mm, 76 mm or 152 mm bore, up to 1,800 mm wide.

5A06.name: High-magnesium corrosion-resistant alloy
5A06.h1: 5A06 O Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
5A06.metaTitle: 5A06 O Aluminium Plate Supplier — Marine Grade | Zorlang
5A06.metaDesc: 5A06 O aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube and profile for marine grade from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
5A06.intro: A grade Chinese shipyards specify by habit, originally from the Russian system. 6 % magnesium — higher than 5083 — and it welds into a superstructure or a pressure structure while holding strength through the heat-affected zone. Ship superstructures, rail bodies, marine decking. O-temper, 0.2–150 mm.

6005A.name: Rail vehicle extrusion alloy
6005A.h1: 6005A T6 Aluminium Plate, Bar, Tube, Profile — GB/T 3880 · ASTM B209
6005A.metaTitle: 6005A T6 Aluminium Profile Supplier — Extrusion | Zorlang
6005A.metaDesc: 6005A T6 aluminium (aluminum) plate, bar, tube and profile for extrusion from a China mill. ASTM B209 compliant, MTC and SGS inspection, cut to size.
6005A.intro: 6005A was drawn up for extrusion. Slightly more silicon and a manganese addition let it hold tolerance through the press quench, so a long car-body profile is still straight after T6. High-speed and metro bodies, underframe beams, modular frames. Wall 0.8–20 mm, section to 400 mm, cut to 12,000 mm.
uses: High-speed and metro car body profiles
